headline: Mistakes to Avoid When Dealing with Smoke Damage in Your Home
articleBody: When your home suffers from smoke damage, it's easy to make missteps that can complicate the cleanup. One common mistake is trying to clean soot yourself with just any old household cleaner. Different types of smoke residue require specific cleaning agents, and using the wrong one can actually spread the damage or set the stains permanently. Another big no-no is not ventilating properly; you want to air out the space as much as possible to help reduce airborne contaminants and odors. Forgetting to document the damage thoroughly with photos and videos for your insurance claim is also a frequent oversight – this documentation is crucial! And often, folks don't realize how quickly smoke odors can penetrate porous materials like upholstery and drywall, so delaying professional cleanup can make full odor removal much harder. Lastly, underestimating the health risks of inhaling smoke particles is a serious mistake; always prioritize safety.
